mission.finding: The adapter converts a future one-off external read into bounded, replayable technical evidence without claiming alpha or cashflow.

flexibility.finding: Target and Helius wire profile remain intentionally frozen for the first consumer; transport, retention and classification seams stay replaceable after measured evidence.

compatibility_history.finding: Accepted A14 bytes are untouched. TASK-08 WssCapture is mediated in the new adapter rather than rewriting historical evidence.

efficiency.finding: One wrapper reuses the existing socket implementation and adds no dependency, scheduler, service or generic provider layer.

research_truth.finding: Missing observations remain unknown, raw bytes precede semantic classification, receipt time is not promoted to event time and no technical capture becomes a trial.

secret_handling.finding: Credential lookup occurs only after durable intent; tests prove fake credentials are absent from files, receipts, output, exceptions and representations.

owner_operability.finding: Dry-run returns one compact safe receipt, execute mode requires the exact phrase, and every prior attempt consumes the one-shot gate while invalid terminal truth remains unresolved.

execution_to_cashflow.finding: This is read-only data feasibility infrastructure and grants no wallet, transaction, inventory, settlement, PnL or NetReturn authority.

monitoring_recovery.finding: Foreground-only monitoring, create-only markers and closed hash-verified terminal receipts expose unknown outcomes; automatic reconciliation remains intentionally absent.

reuse_first.finding: The tested TASK-08 bounded WSS exchange is reused directly; no duplicated socket client or generic streaming platform is introduced.

now.value: One measured stream observation can cheaply falsify whether the frozen route yields usable public trade evidence.
now.evidence: Offline adapter, retention and recovery paths pass deterministic tests; no external observation exists yet.
now.cost_risk: At most one separately authorised foreground WSS session under frozen caps; provider quota and unknown outcome remain material.
now.activation_trigger: Exact-main CI passes and the owner repeats the frozen A14P authority phrase.
now.why: This is now the cheapest remaining discriminator for the named TASK-30 data gap.

watch.value: Could improve coverage only if the first retained stream proves cadence or recovery is the bottleneck.
watch.evidence: No valid external stream exists yet and there is no second consumer.
watch.cost_risk: Would add operations, quota, monitoring and reconciliation burden.
watch.activation_trigger: A retained first capture leaves the named consumer blocked specifically on coverage or repeatability.
watch.why: Building it now would be infrastructure ahead of evidence.
